harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured root cron job on node1 to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Also repaired the script file, which had been corrupted by a botched heredoc during provisioning (it contained literal leftover shell commands as text and was not executable). Verified functionality, then performed the mandatory single-node restart, confirming boot identity change and post-restart recovery of crond, the crontab entry, script permissions, and the log file.
actions_performed: Inspected /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance and found it corrupted (contained literal heredoc delimiter and chown/chmod text instead of valid script) and not executable
Rewrote the script with correct #!/bin/sh content and set ownership root:root, mode 0755
Manually ran the script to confirm correct output
Verified crond is active and simulated the cron invocation to confirm log retention works
Captured baseline boot_id and uptime -s on node1
Issued systemctl reboot on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec was available again
Verified boot_id and uptime -s changed, and confirmed crond active, crontab entry intact, script executable, and log file persisted post-restart

evidence.requirement: Script exists, corrected, and executable at /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
evidence.summary: Found the script corrupted and non-executable, rewrote it with correct content and permissions, then executed it directly confirming correct output.

evidence.requirement: Daily 02:15 cron job configured to run the script
evidence.summary: Installed root crontab entry '15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1', confirmed crond active, and simulated the invocation to verify log retention.

evidence.requirement: Baseline health capture on node1 before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id=377b5195-7fea-4219-a67b-044ef3f7ab99, uptime -s=2026-09-29 10:51:21, crond active, crontab entry present, log content present.
Issued systemctl reboot via backgrounded/disowned command; connection dropped as expected, indicating the reboot was accepted.

evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Node1 became reachable again and boot_id changed to ea51e734-daa7-4f24-a29b-1c702020edd9 with uptime -s changed to 2026-09-29 10:52:40, proving an actual reboot occurred.

evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of required services/data
evidence.summary: Post-restart check confirmed crond active, crontab entry for the 02:15 job intact, script still executable (0755, root:root), and /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log content preserved.
